Status Indicator

Status indicators pair a color dot with a text label to communicate state at a glance — online, offline, busy, away, and more.

Basic Status Indicator

A colored dot beside a small text label.

Online Busy Offline
HTML
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-success">
    <span class="zak-status-dot"></span>
    Online
</span>
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-warning">
    <span class="zak-status-dot"></span>
    Busy
</span>
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-danger">
    <span class="zak-status-dot"></span>
    Offline
</span>

Status with Text Label

Use longer descriptive labels while keeping the dot color as the primary cue.

All systems operational Syncing in progress Deployment complete
HTML
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-info">
    <span class="zak-status-dot"></span>
    Syncing in progress
</span>

Status Colors

All five color variants adjust both the dot and the label text.

Primary Success Warning Danger Info
HTML
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-primary"><span class="zak-status-dot"></span>Primary</span>
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-success"><span class="zak-status-dot"></span>Success</span>
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-warning"><span class="zak-status-dot"></span>Warning</span>
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-danger"><span class="zak-status-dot"></span>Danger</span>
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-info"><span class="zak-status-dot"></span>Info</span>

Pulsing Indicator

Add zak-status-pulse to draw attention to a live or pending state.

Recording live Processing payment Queued for retry
HTML
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-success zak-status-pulse">
    <span class="zak-status-dot"></span>
    Recording live
</span>

Status Indicator in a List

Combine with an avatar and name to show per-member state.

AM
Amira Haddad Online
JL
Jules Laurent In a call
KS
Kenji Sato Offline
HTML
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--zak-space-2);">
    <div class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-sm">AM</div>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;">
        <span>Amira Haddad</span>
        <span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-success">
            <span class="zak-status-dot"></span>
            Online
        </span>
    </div>
</div>

Status Indicator in a Table

Use in table rows to convey record state.

Service Status
API Gateway Healthy
Auth Service Degraded
Billing Worker Down
HTML
<tr>
    <td>API Gateway</td>
    <td><span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-success">
        <span class="zak-status-dot"></span>Healthy
    </span></td>
</tr>

Status as a Badge

Pair the status indicator with the badge component for a compact chip.

Shipped Pending Cancelled
HTML
<span class="zak-badge">
    <span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-success">
        <span class="zak-status-dot"></span>
        Shipped
    </span>
</span>

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-status-indicator    /* Inline-flex row: dot + label */
.zak-status-dot          /* 8px circular dot (neutral by default) */
.zak-status-primary       /* Primary dot + label color */
.zak-status-success       /* Success dot + label color */
.zak-status-warning       /* Warning dot + label color */
.zak-status-danger        /* Danger dot + label color */
.zak-status-info          /* Info dot + label color */
.zak-status-pulse         /* Pulsing dot animation (zak-pulse) */

Accessibility

  • Never rely on color alone — always include a text label alongside the dot.
  • For dot-only usage, provide an equivalent accessible name, e.g. role="status" with visually hidden text.
  • When a live state changes, use aria-live="polite" to announce updates.
  • Keep labels consistent and familiar: Online, Busy, Offline, Away, Pending, Failed.
HTML
<span class="zak-status-indicator zak-status-success" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <span class="zak-status-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <span class="visually-hidden">Connected</span>
    <span>Online</span>
</span>
